name: Leaf Spray
body:
School conjuration; Level druid/shaman 1

CASTING

Casting Time standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 15-ft. cone
Duration instant
Saving Throw Reflex; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Your outstretched hands spew wet, sticky leaves in a 15-ft. cone, coating every creature in the cone. Creatures that fail a Reflex save are blinded until they take a full-round action to remove the leaves from their face.
